row.team_price_text: Growth: $140/yr flat ($11.67/mo, 10k pageviews, up to 3 team members)
row.evidence: Plausible's pricing page lists Single Sign-On (SSO) only on Enterprise (Custom, Contact us), and the SSO docs say "User accounts are provisioned just-in-time"; no SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none, by absence). Team plan changed from June's Starter: the plans doc describes Starter as "one site, solo use, no team or sharing needed", so Growth ($14/mo or $140/yr, up to 3 team members) is the team plan. Pricing is flat per pageview tier, not per seat, so per-user fields are null (June's normalized ~$2/u is dropped). SSO (SAML 2.0, Enterprise only, cannot be bought as an add-on) creates users just-in-time with a default role; IdP removal only ends the Plausible SSO session (max 12h timeout), member removal is manual in Team Settings. June's claim that Plausible 'explicitly does NOT include SCIM' could not be found on any first-party page, so it is dropped. Okta, Entra and Google are configured as custom SAML apps; no catalogue listings found. The Enterprise Sites API can invite and remove site guests (not team members).

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Solo use, no team members; flat pageview-tier pricing.

plans.name: Growth
plans.price_text: $14/month or $140/year ($11.67/mo) for 10k pageviews, up to 3 team members

plans.name: Business
plans.price_text: $19/month or $190/year (10k pageviews), up to 10 team members
plans.notes: Stats API included; its key can call the read-only Sites API endpoints (list guests), not the write endpoints.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented in the pricing page, site or docs sitemaps, SSO docs or Sites API reference; recorded as none by absence.

endpoints.purpose: List teams the key can access
List guests and invitations for a site
Invite a guest (editor or viewer) to a site, idempotent
Remove a guest or invitation from a site (does not delete the user account)

limitations.text: The Sites API manages per-site guests only; team members and team roles are managed in the Team Settings UI. Write endpoints need an Enterprise Sites API key; read-only endpoints also work with a Business-plan Stats API key.

okta.notes: Plausible's guide builds a custom SAML 2.0 app (Create App Integration); okta.com/integrations/plausible returns 404.

entra.notes: SAML setup documented by Plausible; learn.microsoft.com plausible-tutorial returns 404.

google.notes: Custom SAML app per Plausible's guide; no Marketplace listing searched beyond the docs.

open_questions: Plausible never says 'no SCIM' explicitly; status is none by absence.
Whether a JIT-provisioned SSO member is removed or keeps a team seat after IdP removal is not documented (only the session expires).
No audit-log API or user-event webhooks documented.
